polityNote: Portugal (monarchy to 1910-10-05, then republic) throughout; colonies are not in the PRT atoms. First level = administrative districts (continental and, until 1976, insular) and from 1976 the two autonomous regions. The 1936-1959 provinces (statoids: created 1933, abolished 1959-09-21) were a separate tier whose lines did not follow district lines; districts continued underneath and are what is modelled here.

sources.title: Portugal Districts (Statoids, Gwillim Law)
sources.says: From 1900 Portugal was divided into districts; 1926-12-22 Setúbal district split from Lisboa; 1976 Azores (Angra, Horta, Ponta Delgada) and Madeira (Funchal) became autonomous regions.

sources.title: Distritos de Portugal (Wikipédia, oldid 73122317)
sources.says: The district model has had practically no changes since 1835 except the creation of Setúbal district in 1926; the four island districts were suppressed by the 1976 Constitution.

sources.title: Portugal Municipalities (Statoids, Gwillim Law)
sources.says: Municipal change history (1998 onward) lists only municipalities created and parishes transferred inside one district.

spans.dateNote: No district-level change recorded after 1900 other than Setúbal (1926); see unresolved/report on the residual risk of unrecorded parish transfers between districts before 1998.
